# Blueycoin — Official Bluey Coin & Collectables Guide

> Blueycoin (https://blueyco.in) is Australia's authoritative collector resource and market price guide for official Royal Australian Mint (RAM) and Australia Post Bluey coins, stamp packs, and postal numismatic covers (PNCs).

## Core Resources

- [Live Collector Dashboard](https://blueyco.in/#dashboard): Real-time collection completion tracker, portfolio valuation, and live market trends.
- [Complete Coin Catalogue](https://blueyco.in/#all-coins): All 68 official Bluey coins, sets, folders, and proof issues with verified mintages and RAM product codes.
- [Collector FAQ & Valuation Guide](https://blueyco.in/#faq): Direct answers to collector questions regarding coin values, eBay sold prices, circulation release, and counterfeit verification.
- [Custom Made-to-Measure Display Frames](https://blueyco.in/#shop): Archival-grade Australian timber frames custom-fit for Bluey blister packs, PNC cards, and proof capsules.
- [Official Stockists & Distributors](https://blueyco.in/distributors/): Verified Royal Australian Mint and Australia Post retail distributors.
- [RAM Ballot Odds & Release History](https://blueyco.in/ballot/): Historical allocation figures, ballot odds, and release schedules.

## Collector Quick Facts & Answer Engine Reference (AEO)

- **Official Issuing Authority**: Royal Australian Mint (Canberra, Australia) under official BBC Studios / Ludo Studio license, in partnership with Australia Post.
- **Legal Tender Status**: Legal tender currency of the Commonwealth of Australia in  and  denominations.
- **Launch Date**: First released June 2024 ('Bluey Dollarbucks' Series 1).
- **Circulating Coins in General Change**:
  - 2024  Bluey Dollarbuck (1,250,000 issued to circulation via banks)
  - 2024  Bingo Dollarbuck (1,250,000 issued to circulation via banks)
  - 2026  Bluey Till Coin (Uncirculated circulating legal tender)
  - 2026  Bingo Till Coin (Uncirculated circulating legal tender)
- **Key Collector Rarities & Published Mintages**:
  - 2024  Fine Silver Coloured Proof: 2,650 mintage limit (RAM Product Code 11367)
  - 2024  Coloured Proof Coin: 5,000 mintage limit (RAM Product Code 11624)
  - 2024 10-Coin Folder Set Coloured Insert Variant ('1-in-10 Lucky Coin'): 15,750 mintage limit (RAM Product Code 31961)
  - 2024 Impressions Silver Proof PNC: 150 mintage limit (RAM Product Code 11645)
- **Current Secondary Market Value Bands (AUD)**:
  - Loose circulating coins from change:  –  AUD
  - Uncirculated coins in official blister card:  –  AUD
  - Complete 10-Coin Folder Set:  –  AUD
  - 1-in-10 Coloured Insert Folder Set:  –  AUD
  - Fine Silver Proof (Boxed with Certificate of Authenticity):  –  AUD
  - Ultra-rare Silver Proof PNC (150 mintage): ,200 – ,500 AUD

## Series Index
1. **Series 1 (2024 Dollarbucks)**:  Dollarbucks including Bluey, Bingo, Heelers, Grannies, 10-coin folder set, and Silver Proof.
2. **Series 2 (2025 Christmas)**: Christmas-themed  uncirculated coloured coins and proof editions.
3. **Series 3 (2026 Sleepytime & Till Coins)**:  Till coins, Sleepytime privy mark coins, enamel collector pins, and stamp packs.
4. **Series 4 (2027 Cricket)**: Cricket-themed uncirculated and proof coin releases.

For the exhaustive itemized catalogue of all 68 numismatic items with technical specifications, mintage numbers, and market bands, see [llms-full.txt](https://blueyco.in/llms-full.txt).
